system.flavor:
Stand one person through what should flatten them: a wall coming down, a wave over the deck, the edge of a stampede, a fall from the hayloft, a cart that does not stop. They come up bruised and still standing where they were. One friend beside them gets some of the same.

Not enough to shelter a crowd or stop the wall from falling.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 2 and resist 1 unit of forced movement from the Action.

surges.html: An adjacent willing creature also reduces Damage from the same Action by 1.
